Current users and security groups. Nested directory security-group membership is resolved for assignees; nested Exchange role groups, linked groups and Entra shadow-group enumeration are unsupported.
User/SecurityGroup assignment sets only. App data roles, custom roles, delegating assignments, policy/OU/custom/AU/exclusive scopes and arbitrary filters are rejected.
RecipientGroupScope is supported only for Mail Recipients. Direct members only for writes, current group existence/membership rechecked. Implicit organization-wide reads remain available.
